# 🛡️ Webamon Daily Threat Brief — Sunday, 23 August 2026

**TLP:CLEAR** · Estate: 119 campaigns tracked · 779,553 unique domains · 88.3% online

Automated campaign intelligence from Webamon. Here's what our sensors saw across tracked phishing and malware-delivery estates in the last 24 hours.

## 📊 By the numbers (last 24h)

- **68** campaigns with activity
- **22,715** new malicious domains observed
- **721** domains went offline (NXDOMAIN, double-checked)
- **28,528** infrastructure changes (IP / ASN / cert)
- **9,824** new page-title lures
- **200** emerging clusters live on the radar

## 🔍 What moved today

🔺 **Fastest-growing** — [Rolling sqllq.com subdomain phishing](https://intel.webamon.com/campaigns/2f41c3bbec077af4f1c44fff61a425759f949713) added 9,238 new domains this window — active registration/rotation in progress.

🔻 **Takedown movement** — 140 domains in the [Chinese Adult/Leak SPA Network (.lol)](https://intel.webamon.com/campaigns/7a1c18e7bd94decd5b726230c72756851cfc93c0) now resolve NXDOMAIN — takedowns/expiry confirmed by double-checked DNS.

🔁 **Infra rotation** — [Brazilian Online Casino Doorway Network (Cassino Online Brasil, 944bet / 001WIN / 0007bet)](https://intel.webamon.com/campaigns/b78ce38e9f9e53ef933db4c098dc27ef239353a6) moved onto 4,807 new IPs, and [Brazilian Casino Network (0007bet / 001bet / 001win / aavip)](https://intel.webamon.com/campaigns/0899610610c7f95d7b22ee8339b585b573f7a1b2) onto 3,875 new IPs across 1 new ASN — refresh blocklists.

🎭 **Lure refresh** — the same Cassino Online Brasil doorway network deployed 1,184 new page titles — content templates are being rotated.

## 🎯 Campaigns worth a look

**[china k8 phishing portal](https://intel.webamon.com/campaigns/f8baac9d9fa365f2adf7414919aa45f6f37a0450)** — 36,330 domains, 99% online, with 1,176 new domains and 4,667 infrastructure changes in a single window.

**[Fake CAPTCHA Gate Network (Verifying you are human)](https://intel.webamon.com/campaigns/aa0b592f46ffd72770beb082f8234379602ced70)** — 11,887 domains, 100% online; 428 new domains tagged `ctl_20260822` / `nrd_20260822` — freshly registered gate infrastructure.

## 📡 On the radar — emerging clusters

200 clusters are live (200 critical, 0 high) — unattributed infrastructure large enough to promote to tracked campaigns. Sharpest 24h growth:

    cert_config cluster — 7,946 domains, +486 in a day (021hjgcb[.]com)
    dom cluster — 9,459 domains, +320 ("Sorry, the website has been stopped")
    ssl cluster — 9,874 domains, +292 (CNAME Cross-User Banned | Cloudflare)
    cert_config cluster — 8,502 domains, +225 (directideleteddomain[.]com)
    ssl cluster — 7,737 domains, +172 (gn-delete[.]com)
